expectations.text: Uses the app/product flow, not the company brand kit flow
expectations.evidence: Transcript: '1a. Determine brand kit type — This is clearly an App/Product branding request.' Phase 2a used, not Phase 2b.

expectations.text: Generates a logo using generate_asset.py with --prompt flag
expectations.evidence: Logo Generation: 'Tool: generate_asset.py', prompt about flowing checkmark in sky blue

expectations.text: Logo prompt includes 'flat' or 'minimal' style and 'blue' colors and 'checkmark'
expectations.evidence: Prompt: 'A flat, minimal vector logo of a flowing checkmark in sky blue and white'

expectations.text: Generates logo at 1024x1024 with --sizes 512 for the app icon
expectations.evidence: Settings: 1024x1024, PNG, transparent background, with --sizes 512. Renamed to icon-512.png.

expectations.text: Generates favicon with --sizes flag including 16,32 and --ico flag
expectations.evidence: Settings: '--sizes 16,32,180,192,512 and --ico'. Generated all variants plus favicon.ico.

expectations.text: Does NOT write brand-guidelines.md or color-palette.md or typography-guide.md
expectations.evidence: No Write calls for .md documents in transcript. Only logo and favicon generated.

expectations.text: Does NOT generate monochrome or reversed logo variations
expectations.evidence: Only 2 API calls: logo and favicon. No /modify calls for monochrome or reversed variants.

expectations.text: Outputs go to flat ./brandkit/ directory, not subdirectories like ./brandkit/logos/
expectations.evidence: All files at ./brandkit/ level: logo.png, icon-512.png, favicon.png etc. No logos/ or docs/ subdirectories.
